full_page.content:
1936
FATHER SOLANUS, NOTEBOOK NO. 6.
Florence Amange - 19 - in St. Joseph's Retreat ....
Aug. Hagedorn - 60 - cancer of liver etc - operation arranged for Friday. His wife had very remarkable escape from gall stone oper- ation 3 yrs. ago .... they hope ....
Virginia Gill - 21 - had to leave convent (novice) on account of goitre - would like to get employment to pay back Tentat ... bill etc. 19645 Marx Ave.
Theresa Clavemie - 43 - fears operation in gall-bl.
Br. Francis .....
Mrs. F. C. Conlin - 52 - threatened with loss of arm ... lost breast ten yrs. ago and then came here and thanks was cured. ...
Jos. Kado - 17 - grad. - lost speech.
Blank Page
Page 126 Page 127 July 22 Mrs. Helen O'Flynn - 28 - lost her little baby and because of anx- iety lost her mind - in Eloise
Sam Jacolone - 34 - nerveous some like convulsions.
Alex Koons (near Mt. Clemens) - 62 - non Cath. like paralyzed, 2 yrs. in bed , 4 yrs. not able to work - down now to about 60 1bs. Poor wife (lutheran(?) fears she may die first - the strain so great - wonders if she does wrong in asking God to take him out of his misery.
John Waldys - 22 - began to lose his hearing two yrs. ago with pe- culiar fear and shaking. Dr's baffled, now almost totally deaf. Enrolled May Ist & To-day.
Rose Koehler - 56 - nerv break.
Page 128 Blank Page
Page 124 July Page 125 July
